title: Target costing in 40 seconds
caption_hook: The market fixes the price first. Then the cost has to fit.

scenes.say: What if the price comes before the product?
Customers say: we will pay ₹10,000 for this phone, and not a rupee more.
The company wants ₹2,000 profit on each phone, so the phone must cost at most ₹8,000.
Target cost equals target selling price, minus target profit.
scenes.sub: TSP: target price · TP: target profit

scenes.say: Normal costing adds profit to cost. Target costing starts from the price.
But the engineers estimate ₹9,000. That extra ₹1,000 is the cost gap.
They close it by value engineering: same features, smarter design, lower cost.
scenes.title: VALUE ENGINEERING

scenes.say: So remember: price first, cost last.
Follow for one concept every day!
